rules.quote: Reliance Foundation invites first year postgraduate students who are enrolled full-time in an eligible degree programme
First year PG Students who secured a score of 550 - 1,000 in the GATE Examination.

rules.value: UG CGPA 7.5 or above (alternative to GATE)
rules.quote: Students who have scored 7.5 or above in their Undergraduate CGPA (or % normalised to CGPA)

Eligible degree programmes – Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics & Computing, Electrical/or Electronics Engg., Chemical Engg., Mechanical Engg., Renewable & New Energy, Material, Science & Engg. and Life Sciences
Students pursuing their degree through online, remote, distance, hybrid, part-time or any other non-regular modes

rules.value: merit only, all socio-economic backgrounds; aptitude test mandatory
rules.quote: We welcome applicants from all socio-economic backgrounds and scholarships will be granted on the basis of merit.

amount.text: Up to Rs 6 lakh over the degree; up to 100 scholars; 80% advance, 20% on request
amount.quote: The total amount of scholarship available over the duration of the degree programme, will be up to Rs/INR 6 Lakhs.

documents.name: Two letters of reference
documents.quote: Two Letters of Reference: One that attests to your academic capabilities and one that attests to your character and leadership traits

documents.name: Two essays
documents.quote: Two Essays: Personal Statement and Statement of Purpose

deadline.quote: Applications for the 2026-27 scholarships are now closed.
